title: Reference from Central Carolina Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC declined Central Carolina Presbytery’s request to adjudicate two complaints against the Interim Session and the Session’s reference concerning charges against church members. It referred all matters in Case 92-8 back to Presbytery without reaching the merits.
first_summary: Central Carolina Presbytery asked the SJC to adjudicate two complaints and a related reference concerning charges against church members. The SJC declined because adjudicating only the referred matters could render additional, related complaints moot without due consideration. It returned all matters in Case 92-8 to Presbytery without discussing their merits.
summary: Central Carolina Presbytery asked the SJC to adjudicate two complaints and a related reference concerning charges against church members. Although initially found administratively in order, the reference was declined because adjudicating only the formally referred matters could render at least two additional, related complaints moot without due consideration. All matters in Case 92-8 were returned to Presbytery; no underlying merits were decided.
